description: High-effort, single-shot solution (one deterministic submission) for CASCADE DS04 held-out animals. The model learns only from training recordings, uses grouped cross-validation on provided animal IDs (not as predictors), and never touches test labels or groups. It builds a compact feature set from each recording’s fluorescence: robustly standardized fluorescence, its first derivative split into positive/negative parts, and a bank of past lags sampled by seconds using each row’s dt. Training frames are weighted so each recording contributes equally and animals are balanced. A ridge regressor (fit_intercept=True) is selected by maximizing grouped-CV Pearson correlation. The final model is refit on all training frames and applied to test rows. Outputs are nonnegative, finite, per-frame expected spike counts at the required 200 ms target resolution; masking is respected and padded frames yield zero. No external files, pretrained weights, or cross-row leakage are used. Deterministic seeds are set. The full implementation is under 240 lines and CPU-light.
